summary: Verified bug fix for 'Sosta temporanea' tariff persistence. Backend PUT /api/tariffe now accepts sosta_temporanea_giornaliera (previously missing from TariffeUpdate model), so the value persists. Verified via direct API (PUT 30.5 -> GET 30.5) and end-to-end UI flow on /tariffe route: initial=25 -> filled 30.5 -> Salva -> reload -> value remained 30.5. Final value reset back to 25 via API.

issues: Review request mentions /impostazioni-tariffe as the settings page URL, but that route does not exist and redirects to the homepage. The actual working route is /tariffe. If /impostazioni-tariffe was intended as an alias, it needs a router entry; otherwise update documentation.

action_items: Consider adding /impostazioni-tariffe route alias if that URL was expected (currently only /tariffe works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>1300 lines). Consider splitting into modules (tariffe, clienti, lavori, pdf) for maintainability.

TariffeUpdate model duplicates every field from Tariffe — easy for future fields to be forgotten again (this was the exact root cause of this bug). Suggest generating TariffeUpdate dynamically from Tariffe via `create_model` or using `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')` on a partial pattern, or use `Tariffe.model_fields` to build an Optional variant.
seed_data_creation: None. Value modified temporarily to 30.5 then reset to 25.0 via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Tariffe page is at /tariffe (not /impostazioni-tariffe). Auth is disabled. PUT /api/tariffe with partial payload {sosta_temporanea_giornaliera: X} works correctly and triggers client recalculation via /api/tariffe/ricalcola?anno=YEAR.
rca of the issue: Root cause: TariffeUpdate Pydantic model (backend/server.py ~L132-160) was missing the field `sosta_temporanea_giornaliera`. On PUT /api/tariffe the field was silently dropped by Pydantic (extra fields ignored). The handler merged only non-None fields from TariffeUpdate onto current tariffe, so the DB value stayed unchanged. The GET response therefore returned the previous value and the UI 'reverted' the change. Fix: added `sosta_temporanea_giornaliera: Optional[float] = None` to TariffeUpdate. Verified via curl PUT→GET and via full UI flow with page reload. Mitigation suggestion: build the Update model programmatically from Tariffe to prevent future omissions.
